title: Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Volodymyr Mnih, Koray Kavukcuoglu, David Silver, Alex Graves, Ioannis Antonoglou, Daan Wierstra, and Martin Riedmiller submitted 'Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning' to arXiv on December 19, 2013. The paper presents a convolutional neural network trained with a variant of Q-learning to learn control policies directly from raw-pixel input and reports results on seven Atari 2600 games in the Arcade Learning Environment.
significance: A documented publication milestone for an early combination of deep neural-network representation learning with reinforcement learning from high-dimensional visual input.
